description: Add reusable crash-handling to outram-park-digital-twin-engine::app_scaffold: (1) ThreadHealth/CrashReport shared flag; (2) spawn_monitored + spawn_physics_thread_monitored wrap the thread body in catch_unwind and record the panic message; (3) show_crash_modal_if_crashed egui::Modal helper telling the user to restart; (4) SharedState made lock-poison-safe so the GUI reader does not cascade-panic. Wire htgr_sim_v1 (scaffold) and fhr_sim_v2 (engine, raw Arc<Mutex>). tampines fhr_sim_v2 copy NOT mirrored: tampines crate does not depend on the engine crate (would need a new dev-dep + risks a dep cycle) — tracked as follow-up.
title: app_scaffold: thread-panic crash detection + restart notification modal for sims

description: The thermal pincell (op-6tz.12) is LIVE at k_inf=1.39802+/-0.00652 but only verified (physical band), not validated. Run HIGH-tier (net-fetch from_endf) U235/238/O16 + real OpenMC pincell with same materials/geometry and compare k_inf. See REVIEW_MANIFEST op-6tz-thermal-pincell.

notes.author: teddy0@snrsi-arch-desktop
notes.content:
Code-to-code comparison DONE (2026-07-15) vs openmc pincell.ipynb stored output (openmc-notebooks @ cf1e5db, MIT). SAME spec confirmed: 3% UO2 @10.0 g/cc, fuel r=0.39 / clad 0.46 cm, pitch 1.26 cm, Zr clad, water + c_H_in_H2O, reflective BC, 293.6 K.
  RESULT: outram-mc k_inf = 1.39802 ± 0.00652  vs  OpenMC 1.40544 ± 0.00302.
  Δk = -742 pcm (-0.531%); combined σ = 0.00719 → agree within 1.03σ (statistically consistent).
  CAVEATS (why this is a cross-check, not a validation): (a) different data — ours = CORE WMP (ENDF/B-VII.1) + free-gas + tsl-HinH2O (ENDF/B-VIII.0); notebook = NNDC HDF5 pointwise CE; library differences alone routinely ~100s pcm. (b) our σ is 2x larger (600 part x 60 active vs 1000 x 90). (c) WMP+free-gas resonance treatment vs pointwise CE — U-238 capture fidelity differs.
  Not closed: a same-data, higher-statistics run (and ideally an actual OpenMC run on identical XS) would make this a true validation. Left open for that.

title: outram-mc: benchmark-validate thermal UO2 pincell k_inf vs real OpenMC
